title: COVID-19 vaccination (2024–25 vaccine) for persons age 18 who are not moderately or severely immunocompromised
action: Ensure at least one dose of 2024–25 COVID-19 vaccine (Moderna, Pfizer-BioNTech or Novavax; unvaccinated Novavax recipients need 2 doses) for 18-year-olds who are not moderately or severely immunocompromised.

denominator.quote: Age 18 years who are NOT moderately or severely

derived.window: Text requires a dose of the 2024–25 vaccine; the season start date is not in the text, so the window is assumed to open Aug 1 of the year before measurement year 2025 (human must confirm season dates)

numerator.note: Product is not distinguishable in vocabulary; an unvaccinated person who received Novavax needs 2 doses (0, 3–8 weeks), which min_count 1 does not enforce.

exclusions.quote: Age 18 years who ARE moderately or severely
exclusions.note: Text excludes only moderately or severely immunocompromised persons (they follow a separate multi-dose schedule); the immunocompromised concept may be broader, which only removes patients from the rule.
